draft.emotion: warm and observant, seeing a pair of people together
notes: Used for people (a romantic couple or a duo on stage/screen). For pairs of objects like shoes or glasses, use 'đôi' or 'cặp' instead.

senses.definition: two people in a romantic relationship, or who regularly appear or work together as a pair

examples.text: Họ là một cặp đôi hạnh phúc.
examples.emotion: admiring and pleased, pointing out a nice pairing

draftBefore.emotion: warm and observant, seeing a pair of people together
notes: Use 'cặp đôi' to refer to two people in a romantic relationship. It emphasizes the pair as a unit.
Do not confuse this with 'hai người', which simply means 'two people' without implying they are a couple.

senses.definition: Two people who are in a romantic relationship.

examples.text: Họ là một cặp đôi hạnh phúc.
examples.emotion: admiring and pleased, pointing out a nice pairing

senses.definition: A set of two things or people that go together.

examples.text: Cặp đôi này rất hợp nhau khi làm việc.
examples.translation: This pair works very well together.
examples.emotion: professional and impressed, noting a successful team-up

faults.quote: A set of two things or people that go together.
faults.why: 'Cặp đôi' is almost exclusively for people (romantic or duo), not inanimate things ('cặp').

faults.quote: Use 'cặp đôi' to refer to two people in a romantic relationship.
